title: Aundha Nagnath Temple
scope: The standing dark-stone Aundha Nagnath temple with three porticoes, star-shaped halls, the rebuilt white shikhara and the Nandi pavilion immediately outside the historical western entrance.
limitations: Stone friezes and portions of the pale shikhara are simplified at close range. The principal shrine and western pavilion are modeled from the measured plan.
The exterior remains limited to the standing temple, porticoes and west pavilion. The walls, tank and unrelated precinct buildings are outside the modeled structure.
